dataset.name: SDHB-mutant pheochromocytoma and paraganglioma (A5, 2025)
dataset.description: Independent international cohort of hereditary SDHB-mutant pheochromocytomas and paragangliomas restricted to primary tumors with whole-transcriptome sequencing and linked overall survival.
dataset.cohort_context: Hereditary SDHB-mutant disease; this molecularly selected cohort is not population-matched to an unselected TCGA-PCPG cohort. Overall survival is measured from first pathologic diagnosis, so recurrence- or metastasis-only transcriptomes are excluded to avoid using expression measured after the endpoint time origin.

metadata.source_label_note: The cBioPortal accession retains a legacy HNSC prefix, but every included sample is annotated as paraganglioma (OncoTree PGNG).
metadata.curation_note: Only source-labelled whole-transcriptome-sequenced primary tumors are eligible. One primary is selected per patient using a prespecified source-label order. Patients represented only by a recurrence or metastasis are excluded because the article's Supplementary Data 1 defines overall survival and follow-up from first diagnosis; the cBioPortal column description that refers to sample sequencing is inconsistent with that primary source.

expression.label: TMM-normalized log2 CPM
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Repeated rows with the same supplied symbol are averaged sample-wise; different source identifiers are never merged implicitly.
expression.scale_note: The cBioPortal profile label abbreviates the matrix as CPM, but the published analysis code computes TMM-normalized log2 CPM with edgeR::cpm(log=TRUE), and the supplied matrix contains signed log-scale values. TRACE Explorer therefore preserves the provided values without a second logarithm.

endpoints.label: Overall survival
endpoints.time_origin: First pathologic diagnosis of pheochromocytoma or paraganglioma
